entries.name: BThwani Task Discovery
entries.purpose: Progressive remediation discovery: runs the parallel read-only inventory and baseline scripts under tools/remediation/discovery/, rejects any tracked mutation, and uploads the evidence bundle as an artifact. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-B).

entries.name: BThwani Progressive Remediation Orchestrator
entries.purpose: Progressive remediation orchestrator: validates the governed contracts and evaluates the requested phase (select-next, validate-contract, required-proof, reconcile-state) read-only, rejects any tracked mutation, and uploads the decision evidence as an artifact. It decides which task-*.yml workflows to dispatch next; it never dispatches them itself in wave P0-C. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-C).

entries.name: BThwani Task Static Analysis
entries.purpose: Task-scoped STATIC_SCOPED verification profile: no-broken-imports, dependency-graph, ast-grep-rules, logic-coverage. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Contract Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped contract binding proof: contracts:lint, openapi:verify:dsh, api-binding, backend-api-binding. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Backend and Database Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped Go backend and migration verification against an isolated per-task-per-service Postgres database. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task UI and Runtime Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped affected typecheck/lint/test plus an optional Docker runtime smoke profile. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Mobile Native Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped static Expo/mobile configuration verification; records on-device native proof as NEEDS_EVIDENCE (planned wave P1-C). Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Security and Isolation Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped security boundary and secrets guards; records cross-tenant runtime proof as NEEDS_EVIDENCE (planned wave P1-B). Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Resilience Verification
entries.purpose: Registered honest placeholder for the resilience dimension (planned wave P1-C); always records NEEDS_EVIDENCE, never a fabricated pass. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Performance Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped performance and bundle budget verification. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Cleanup Verification
entries.purpose: Task-scoped cleanup and hygiene guards; read-only proof only, never deletes anything itself. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Task Final Verification
entries.purpose: Aggregates the governed remediation contracts, reconciles task state, and renders the same-commit decision summary. Part of governance/remediation/ (wave P0-D).

entries.name: BThwani Contextual CI
entries.purpose: Root orchestrator: detects affected scope and fans out to the reusable verification workflows with one fail-closed aggregate result.

entries.name: BThwani Policy Verification
entries.purpose: Nomenclature plus governance, workflow, security, and infrastructure policy guards.

entries.name: BThwani Node Diagnostics
entries.purpose: UI purity, dead-code, logic, accessibility, dependency, structure, performance, contract, and diff-hygiene diagnostics.

entries.name: BThwani Node Verification
entries.purpose: Nx typecheck, lint, test, and build over all or affected projects plus journey and platform change-set gates.

entries.name: BThwani Backend Verification
entries.purpose: Dynamic Go backend matrix: applies migrations then runs go test and go build per affected service.

entries.name: BThwani Runtime Proof
entries.purpose: Docker runtime bring-up, bootstrap, smoke, and teardown when runtime proof is required.

entries.name: DSH Database Contract
entries.purpose: Verifies the canonical DSH database path against a PostgreSQL service.

entries.name: JRN-020-025 Sambassam Verification
entries.purpose: Fullstack boundary, WLT financial boundary, and governed route exposure for journeys 020 to 025.

entries.name: BThwani Lockfile Snapshot
entries.purpose: Regenerates a frozen-install-compatible lockfile candidate and uploads it as an artifact; never commits.

entries.name: BThwani Manual Patch Verification
entries.purpose: Manual patch verification: verifies whatever is already at the requested source_ref (typically a task's already-repaired branch) against the full logic, contract, build, test, database, security, and runtime gates, applies only the pre-existing policy-governed records cleanup, and exports a signed evidence patch artifact without any privileged write. GAP-0002 (wave R) removed every general auto-repair step (mobile source sync, OpenAPI generation, dependency dedupe, lint --fix, go mod tidy, gofmt) that previously ran before verification.
